description: Missing-read contract for the data-files `files` SDK. read() returns None / null / (nil,false) only for a 404 because absence is the normal case. Deleting a missing key succeeds and is idempotent. All other non-2xx statuses (401 / 403 / 429 / 5xx) are real failures and must raise or return a Files error, never be treated as missing.
